description: First Results Project Hotspot Drilling is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Project Hotspot drilled 3 slim hole exploratory wells in southern Idaho, each just under 2 km deep. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Geothermal Energy, Natural Resources. Its keywords are geothermal, Snake River Plain, Yellowstone Hotspot, Project Hotspot, Idaho, drilling. The portal shows 2017-05-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
